title: hieracium murorum subsp. distinctum
intro: Hieracium murorum subsp. distinctum, commonly known as Hawkweed or Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium murorum subsp. distinctum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of this plant in modern medicine.
